authority: This remediation authorizes exactly one additional production behavior fix exposed by remediation-v2 real-filesystem testing. It is execution-authoritative over all prior iteration-007 contracts where it adds detail. Every replacement prepare receipt, execution spec, checkpoint metadata, execution receipt, validator, and test must bind all seven contract file hashes.

confirmed_defect.observation: With a real stable directory guard and real inherited status publisher, a pre-existing file named EXTRA was not rejected. Publication returned success and left ACCEPTED, EXTRA, and accepted_receipt.json.

authorized_production_fix.scope: Add fail-closed exact direct-child artifact-set validation around every real checkpoint and status publication path used by iteration007.

filesystem_evidence.enumeration: Enumerate the real guarded output directory's direct children without following links. Record every name, file type, link/reparse status, byte size, and SHA-256 for regular files.
filesystem_evidence.directory_guard: Before and after every enumeration and publication, require the same stable directory guard to remain bound to the exact output directory and its verified parent identity.
filesystem_evidence.entry_rules: Every expected entry must be a direct regular file with the exact canonical name, must not be a directory, symlink, junction, or reparse point, and must match any held file identity/hash evidence available for it.
filesystem_evidence.unexpected_entry: Any missing, extra, wrong-type, linked, reparse, renamed, duplicate, or unverified entry is an output-artifact-set error.

publication_wrapping: Iteration007 must not call the inherited status publisher directly outside one exact-allowlist wrapper.
Every checkpoint-publication call must perform the exact empty-set precheck and candidate-only postcheck.
Every status-publication call must perform the appropriate exact precheck and terminal exact postcheck.
A precheck mismatch raises before creating a checkpoint, receipt, or marker and must not be converted into a canonical accepted or rejected result.

If a post-status check detects contamination introduced during publication, verify and remove only the receipt and marker newly owned by that call, preserve any already verified candidate checkpoint, and raise without a canonical terminal claim.

If a post-checkpoint check detects contamination after public checkpoint identity exists, preserve that one checkpoint, create no receipt or marker, create no replacement checkpoint, and raise as an unclaimed execution failure.
Never delete, rename, overwrite, or adopt an unexpected entry.
forbidden_changes: weakening stable directory or stable file guards
ignoring an unexpected entry because its name is not reserved
cleaning an unexpected entry to make the allowlist pass
publishing a canonical status after an artifact-set mismatch
changing checkpoint, receipt, or marker contents or names
changing any training, model, gate, threshold, data, optimizer, or schedule behavior

required_fix_tests: The confirmed pre-existing EXTRA case raises before the real status publisher creates a receipt or marker.
Real temporary-filesystem publication produces each exact accepted, rejected, and zero-step artifact set and no extra entries.
An extra regular file, directory, symlink, junction, or reparse entry fails the real wrapper before publication.
An entry injected between precheck and postcheck causes cleanup of only newly owned status files and leaves no canonical terminal claim.
A checkpoint-identity handoff retains the same candidate.pt identity and never creates a second checkpoint.
A candidate.pt plus EXTRA cannot enter post-step rejection status publication.
Opposite receipt/marker, collision, overwrite, renamed file, and second-checkpoint cases fail closed.

replacement_prepare.publication: Create exactly once with CREATE_NEW semantics only after both authorized production fixes, every remediation-v2/v3/v4 test, and all regressions pass. Preserve prepare v1 and v2 byte-exact.

stop_rule: After the single artifact-allowlist fix, the directional-membership fix, every required production-path test, and all regressions pass, generate prepare v3 exactly once and stop for independent code and numerical-provenance audits before execution-spec authoring.
